requirements.requirement: The system must validate that the weighting schema accepts valid default and user-defined weights without errors.
The system must reject weighting inputs that violate schema constraints (e.g., missing required fields or invalid data types).
The system must compute identical scores when default weights are applied compared to baseline scoring logic.
The system must recompute scores correctly when valid custom weights are applied across multiple measures.
The system must normalize weights appropriately when partial weight sets are provided.
The system must fall back to default weights when invalid or incomplete weight configurations are provided.
The system must expose an API endpoint that accepts weight parameters and returns recomputed scores matching the defined contract.
The system must return an error response when the weights API receives malformed or invalid payloads.
The system must ensure API responses include metadata indicating whether default or custom weights were used.
The system must update displayed scores in the UI when a user adjusts weights via frontend controls.
The system must preserve UI stability and not crash when extreme but valid weight values are applied.
The system must maintain consistent scoring outputs between backend unit tests and end-to-end integration tests.
